title: Stop every scope a pane leaves: on project close and when a dispatch replaces a pane's shell
notes: Left by #255. (1) Project close drops its panes through dropPane, not pane.close, so their scopes are not stopped: a dev server detached in any pane of a closed project keeps running. Route project.close's pane teardown through pane.close (or the same stop port) so every scope goes. (2) A dispatch that replaces a pane's shell in place (pane.dispatch on an open pane) starts a new scope and leaves the old one running: stop the old unit before or right after the new shell starts. Through the pane and project actions only (actions-rule-1); decision tests for both; lower the matching bypass counts. Hand check on throwaway scopes only. Docs: docs/processes (close the open question), history.
